content:
MUFON Sedona Welcomes Diana Palm for a Fascinating Exploration of the Afterlife and Extraterrestrial Connections

SEDONA, AZ – The Mutual UFO Network (MUFON) Sedona invites experiencers, researchers, and the curious to a thought-provoking presentation on Sunday, November 8, featuring acclaimed medium, spiritual healer, and paranormal investigator Diana Palm. Her presentation promises an extraordinary journey beyond conventional understanding.

“Through decades of personal experience and research,” she said.  “I’ve discovered remarkable connections between the spirit world and UFO phenomena. I believe the same spiritual protection practices that safeguard us from unwanted spirit interference may also protect us during extraterrestrial encounters—because true spiritual sovereignty transcends all dimensions.”

With more than three decades of experience investigating spirit communication, energy healing, and paranormal phenomena, Diana Palm has become a respected voice in the exploration of consciousness and life beyond death. Founder of Paranormal Rescue Investigations and the Spiritual Academy for Mediumship & Entity Clearing, she has helped countless individuals through grief healing, spirit encounters, and spiritual awakening. She is also the creator-author of the Grief Ease app and several books exploring the afterlife, spiritual warfare, and interdimensional realities.

In her presentation, Palm will share firsthand accounts of communicating with spirits while simultaneously encountering extraterrestrial presences in the unseen realms. Her unique perspective bridges the worlds of paranormal research, mediumship, and UFO phenomena, offering fresh insights into consciousness and the possibility that life continues beyond physical death.

Whether you are a longtime UFO experiencer, a paranormal enthusiast, or a seeker of deeper truths, this presentation will challenge assumptions and inspire new possibilities. Join MUFON Sedona for an unforgettable exploration of the mysteries that connect the afterlife, extraterrestrial intelligence, and the eternal journey of the soul.
